description: PROPOSED successor, for the 7 November competition, of docs/optimization/echelon-stack-upgrade/lock/dependency-lock.source.json (the echelon-current 1.37.0 lock ODR-ESU-01 proposes). It differs from that source only in what Conditor v0.10.21 changes: conditor is v0.10.21 at 528ef4576fc79540953226b7dcfd3957654e3a29, the release the competition toolchain lock pins (ODR-COMP-P14 A; its eight artifact digests, those of the release checksums.txt, are in kickoff/competition/toolchain.lock.proposed.json conditor.artifacts), and forma-workflow 1.2.0, which its indy-init preset installs (ODR-COMP-P14 A: an owner exemption, not an echelon-current 1.37.0 selection), is locked by its npm version and tarball digest. Generated into dependency-lock.json beside it by tools/stack-drift/stack-drift.fsx lock against echelon-registry 5752402. Not adopted: adoption is owner decision ODR-COMP-P15 (docs/v416-competition-decisions/proposals/owner-decision-requests.json).
